blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Foreign Secretary Ma. Theresa Lazaro offered prayers on behalf of Filipino Catholics for Pope Leo XIV as he recovers from lung cancer surgery, during a meeting with a senior Vatican official marking 75 years of diplomatic relations between the Philippines and the Holy See. Lazaro met with Archbishop Paul Gallagher, the Holy See’s secretary for relations with states and international organizations, at the Apostolic Palace in the Vatican on Friday, according to a Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) on Saturday. “Secretary Lazaro conveyed the well wishes and heartfelt prayers of the Filipino Catholic faithful for the healing and […]...
